text:
Ava (AE): Looping folks — final preflight with CinderAI before we send the RFP response. Main asks from their CTO: POC cost tiers, KMS/HSM support, egress policy, and a firm timeline. Need short clear answers for execs by EOD.

Ravi (Solutions): Can we commit to a 6-week POC on Dedicated GPUs with an option to flip to Private (VPC) within 30 days if they sign? Also they want throughput targets: 200 req/s for text gen and ~5k embeddings/min.

Eli (Pricing): Quick back-of-envelope: 6-week Dedicated POC estimate = base reserved commit $18,000/mo + usage buffer ~$6,000 => ~30k total for the POC. I'll prepare a 2-tier quote: "Standard POC" and "Enterprise POC" with HSM as an add-on.

Morgan (SRE): For Dedicated, baseline SLA we can offer during POC is 99.5% with p95 latency target ~100ms for 8k sequence. If they want KV-cache persistence between sessions we should run Dedicated with sticky nodes — that's a config change and may add infra footprint (call out as cost risk).

Priya (Security): On the questionnaire: we support customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSM via partner gateway. We don't ship a managed HSM appliance by default. FedRAMP is not available out of the box; we can provide SOC2 Type II and pen test reports. I'll draft concise RFI answers.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: DEPL-4821 — https://redwood.prod/deploy/DEPL-4821

Ava (AE): Customer asked for a one-page capability matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private focusing on: data residency, SLAs, HSM support, and time-to-prod. Can someone mock a one-pager by EOD?

Ravi (Solutions): I'll draft the matrix. Example row for HSM: Hosted -> "Partner HSM (BYO)"; Dedicated -> "Supported (config)"; Private -> "Customer-managed HSM (on-prem/VPC)". I'll include a sample config snippet for enabling HSM in Dedicated:

```yaml
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  hsm: true
  kms_provider: aws-kms
  kv_cache_persistence: false
```

Eli (Pricing): Uploaded provisional quote: https://drive.redwood.com/poctiers/CinderAI-estimate (please don't share externally yet). Note enterprise POC includes optional HSM add-on at ~$4k/mo.

Priya (Security): Short RFI answer draft for Q12 (data residency): "Data can be isolated to a customer VPC in Private mode. For Hosted and Dedicated, payloads are encrypted in transit and at rest; telemetry logs retained for 30 days by default unless contract specifies longer retention or deletion."

Morgan (SRE): SLA wording we should use in the RFP: "99.5% uptime for Dedicated POC, p95 latency <= 100ms for up to 200 rps; Auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant on capacity events."

Ava (AE): Action items: Eli finalize quote by 3pm PT; Ravi attach matrix + example config; Priya upload security answers + SOC2 excerpt; Morgan confirm final SLA sentence. I'll consolidate and send the RFP response tonight. :thumbsup: 

Eli (Pricing): On it.

Ravi (Solutions): Draft will be in the channel in ~2h.

Priya (Security): I'll upload the security bundle to the drive link and tag it.

Morgan (SRE): I'll review SLA phrasing and post final language here.

Ava (AE): Thanks team — if anything blocks the numbers or HSM story ping me direct.
